title: feat(components): a kind:'react' page's author scope injects useDataInvalidation (objectui#10887)
body:
Fixes #10887
Clause-②: yes — one identifier, `useDataInvalidation`, joins the published author scope of `kind: 'react'` pages, and `content/docs/guide/react-pages.md` teaches it.

**Why a closing keyword.** The card has three members. Members 1 and 2 landed in PR #10898 (squash `9f0c84a44`). This PR lands member 3, ruled A (ruling `5864668610`), so all three are in once it merges. The four review notes from the members 1 and 2 round ride this round: (a) and (d) are text and are corrected here; (b) and (c) need a behaviour change, so they are reported as findings and not changed here (see Acceptance notes). The objectstack half of the ruling (the docs page, the skill and the showcase pages) is carried by objectstack-ai/objectstack#20395. The `Blocked-by` line on objectui#10519 is the seat's to update; this PR does not touch that card.

## What changed

- **`@object-ui/components`, the react-page renderer.** `ReactKindPage` injects `useDataInvalidation` from `@object-ui/react` into the author scope, beside `useAdapter`. It is the same hook `ListView` reads to refresh its rows: `useDataInvalidation('object')` returns a nonce that moves when the bus reports a write to that object, or `'*'`. A page names it in the dependency list of the effect that reads through `useAdapter`, and that read re-runs in place. The hook is a module-level function, and the scope memo still depends on the schema and the adapter only, so the scope keeps its identity and no page recompiles or loses state. The file header's scope list gains the entry.
- **The react-pages guide.** The scope table gains a `useDataInvalidation` row. The Live data example reads `const changed = useDataInvalidation('showcase_project')` and names `changed` in the effect's dependency array, followed by one sentence on why: the nonce moves each time the bus reports a write to that object, so the effect reads again in place without remounting the page.
- **Changeset** `10887-react-page-data-invalidation`: `minor` for `@object-ui/components`, `Clause-②: yes`.
- **No new dependency edge.** `useDataInvalidation` is exported by `@object-ui/react`, which `@object-ui/components` already depends on and already imports `useAdapter` from.

## Review notes from the members 1 and 2 round (`5864212493`)

| note | what it said | here |
| --- | --- | --- |
| (a) | the plugin-view changeset's "switches off that view's own bus reader" is imprecise for a gantt handed zero rows | **Corrected (text).** The pending changeset `10887-object-view-non-grid-bus-reader` now names the exception: a gantt handed zero rows still queries for itself and keeps its own bus reader (objectui#7333). Frontmatter byte-identical (the first three lines hash the same before and after); the file has not shipped (no CHANGELOG carries its text), so it is corrected in place. The same imprecision in `ObjectView`'s member 1 comment is corrected too. |
| (b) | `fetchDrawsView` is a deny-list, so a host `views` entry the renderer does not draw adds one unused read | **Not changed: behaviour.** An allow-list changes which views subscribe. Reported as a finding. |
| (c) | a calendar re-read flashes its loading placeholder | **Not changed: behaviour.** `ObjectView`'s non-grid fetch sets `loading` on every run and passes it to the view, and `ObjectCalendar` shows it; a silent re-read changes behaviour. Reported as a finding. |
| (d) | the `identityKey` comment is incomplete | **Corrected (comment).** It now says the non-grid fetch re-reads when `refreshKey` moves or when the bus reports a change to the object (objectui#10887), that a gantt handed rows draws them while a gantt handed zero rows queries for itself (objectui#7333), and that `tree` reads the bus itself (objectui#10778). |

Both comment edits sit inside `ObjectView`'s component body, so neither reaches a published `.d.ts`; no plugin-view surface moves and the plugin-view changeset keeps its `patch`.

## Pin, through a real react page

`packages/components/src/__tests__/react-page-invalidation.test.tsx`. The page is compiled from source by `@object-ui/react-runtime` inside the real `ReactKindPage`, dispatched by the real `PageRenderer` for `type: 'home'`; the events go through the real bus (`notifyDataChanged`). Only the adapter is a stand-in, so reads can be counted. The page source is the guide's Live data pattern with the nonce.

- One record-scoped bus event on `showcase_project` re-runs the page's `find` exactly once (1 to 2), the re-read rows reach the page, and a counter the user clicked before the event still reads 1, so the page was not remounted.
- Lit control: an event on `showcase_invoice` does not re-run the read (`find` stays at 1, the rows stay the first answer), while a bare `useDataInvalidation('showcase_invoice')` reader mounted beside the page moves from 0 to 1, so the event demonstrably reached the bus.

## One case the widened scope can break

The scope's names become the parameters of the function the page source is evaluated in. A page that declares its own top-level `const` or `let` named `useDataInvalidation` therefore now fails with a `SyntaxError` (`Identifier 'useDataInvalidation' has already been declared`), shown in the page's error panel; a `function` or `var` declaration of that name only shadows the injected one. Measured once through the real renderer with a throwaway test (panel shown, message as quoted), not kept. Census: no page source in objectui (apps, examples, content, skills) or in objectstack `origin/main` (examples, content, skills, packages) declares the name. The changeset states this case.

## Serial

Open PRs, read again just before this PR (12 open, every file list complete under 100 entries): none touches `react-page.tsx`, the `react-page-*` tests, `react-pages.md` or the `10887-*` changesets. One touches `ObjectView.tsx`: PR #10967 (opened after this claim, route 2's named-view reads). `git merge-tree --write-tree` of this head against its head `600cf8901`: clean, exit 0. Its hunks and this PR's two comment hunks do not overlap. PR #10777 touches `PageView.tsx`, its tests and its own changesets only.

## Acceptance notes

- **(b), not filed.** `ObjectView`'s `fetchDrawsView` names the types it excludes (`grid`, `tree`, `chart`) rather than the types `generateViewSchema` draws, so a view type `generateViewSchema` has no case for (it returns `null`, and `renderContent` falls through to `ObjectGrid`, which queries for itself) still subscribes here and re-reads once per matching event, for rows nothing renders. Pre-existing shape of member 1; carrier: none.
- **(c), not filed.** The non-grid fetch sets `loading` at the start of every run, including a bus re-read, and `ObjectCalendar` swaps to its loading placeholder while it is set, the same flash as the calendar's own objectui#10572 reader. A silent re-read would change behaviour; carrier: none.
- **objectstack half, beyond objectstack-ai/objectstack#20395's named files.** The spec's generated react-blocks reference (`skills/objectstack-ui/references/react-blocks.md`, written by `packages/spec/scripts/build-react-blocks-contract.ts`) lists the injected scope as `React`, `useAdapter`, `data`, `variables`, `page`. After this lands that list is incomplete. objectstack-ai/objectstack#20395 names `react-pages.mdx`, `rules/pages.md` and the showcase pages, not this generator; it is the natural carrier.
